admission.reported_observation: only event_kind observation, raw text unchanged -> reported_progress/current_activity
admission.accepted_plan: only event_kind plan and accepted=true, raw text unchanged -> pending_experiment/current_activity
admission.other_claim_types: not indexed; preserve original typed event and record reason; no SQL promotion or prefix substitution

activity_mapping: Only the isolated synthetic Store session uses its existing modular_rover activity API; this is not equivalence to the original logical workshop scope or permission to widen production activities
rankings: pure cosine over actual Store eligible_memory_embeddings
actual Store recall_candidates with profile vector (existing legacy lexical plus RRF)
tie_break: Dense and final RRF use actual Store generated memory_id; legacy lexical retains its existing updated_at and row-order behavior. Preserve ID map and dense full-ranking/returned-RRF equal-score groups; Store does not expose RRF candidates beyond its five-row return, so boundary ties outside that return remain unobserved. No label-dependent tie changes.
metrics: Preserve original sufficient_evidence_sets; separately report original-positive denominator and positive cases with at least one whole set admitted to Store; no reclassification of original no-evidence labels
budget_boundary: Natural frozen source texts may never fill 2400 chars; assert all selected text remains whole and in budget, and identify hard-overflow coverage as a separate fake-vector unit test
limits: This subset Store diagnosis does not inherit the original 60-source BGE quality gate
Legacy Store lexical+RRF is not the frozen lexical method or pure BGE
No default recall/context changes, model runs, user database reads, or source-label changes
SQLite mutation controls are labeled distinctly from public Store API controls
